sqf: private _loc = (nearestLocations [[worldSize/2, worldSize/2, 0], ['NameCity','NameCityCapital','NameVillage'], 50000]) select {(toLower (text _x)) find 'mazem' >= 0}; if (count _loc == 0) exitWith { systemChat 'ERROR: Mazemovo not found!'; }; private _cityPos = position (_loc select 0); systemChat format ['[OPFOR Command] Fortifying %1 - deploying armor!', text (_loc select 0)]; private _tanks = ['CUP_O_T72_RU','CUP_O_T72_RU','CUP_O_T90_RU','CUP_O_BMP2_RU']; { private _spawnPos = [(_cityPos select 0) + (random 200) - 100, (_cityPos select 1) + (random 200) - 100, 0]; private _grp = createGroup EAST; private _veh = createVehicle [_x, _spawnPos, [], 0, 'NONE']; createVehicleCrew _veh; (crew _veh) joinSilent _grp; _grp setBehaviour 'AWARE'; _grp setCombatMode 'RED'; [_grp, _cityPos, 150] call BIS_fnc_taskPatrol; } forEach _tanks; systemChat '[OPFOR] Heavy armor deployed!';
